note: The rows of Star (Mantra), in the default order. kind "app": a Swift .app, opened and quit directly by the star. kind "lua": still a Hammerspoon app, toggled through hs (STAR.toggleKey). Converting an app to Swift changes only its row here: kind "app" and "app" = its path in /Applications. build.sh installs this file as ~/.config/star-rows.json.

rows.name: Swift Matrix (Mantra) (what runs now and what starts with the Mac: quit it, or switch its auto-start)
rows.about: A simple task manager: every app running and everything that starts at login, each with QUIT and AUTO-START

rows.name: Automated Mouse Actions
rows.about: When a pop-up appears, puts the pointer on its default button

rows.name: Enter sends in Claude
rows.about: A plain Return sends the message in a claude.ai tab; Shift+Return makes a new line

rows.name: Buckets
rows.about: The Hammerspoon keyboard: clipboard dispenser, F keys, hand and deck

rows.name: Sister app (MANTRA CHAT)
rows.about: MANTRA CHAT: the page that mirrors this session and reads it aloud

rows.name: Macro Recorder
rows.about: Records what you do and plays it back; the star reddens while it records

rows.name: Download Monitor
rows.about: Every download on this Mac, each with its own bar

rows.name: Voices (how the computer talks)
rows.about: The ears and the mouth: Whisper listening, the cloned voice speaking

rows.name: DaVinci Resolve Actions
rows.about: Everything for Resolve in one app: pages on ⌥`, HD/UHD, the import button, one-button actions

rows.name: Voice cloning (clone, choose, test every voice)
rows.about: Clone a voice, choose which one talks, and test every voice you have

rows.name: Find a file (the terminal's find as a page)
rows.about: The terminal's find as a page: a folder, a name, the hits in four views

rows.name: Spotlight (an index for one folder)
rows.about: Builds a Spotlight index for one folder alone, and searches inside it

rows.name: Dock Switcher (⌃` over everything on the Dock, running or not)
rows.about: Control-backtick switches between everything on the Dock, running or not

rows.name: App Store
rows.about: Search for an app, fetch the developer's own .dmg, install it

rows.name: Apple Door
rows.about: Opens Apple's update servers for thirty minutes, then shuts them again

rows.name: Ableton Live Actions
rows.about: Everything for Live in one app: A1, MIDI to MK Control, MIDI to Key Stroke

rows.name: Ableton Assistant A1 (Space continues; 1 and 2 zoom; h splits; 7, 8 and 9 are the markers (back, set or delete, on); the arrows walk the transients and ⌘ with them walks the tracks; I and O jump to the next transient and mark the loop's in and out on its waveform's zero, L turns the loop on; the markers on the page, two ticked are the loop; the last set opens where you stopped; the time blob is the clock of the insert point; every override has its tick on the page)
rows.about: Ableton fitted to your hands: the keys, the markers, the loop and the clock blob

rows.name: Key Ring Tester (every key in ~/Downloads/API, one real call each)
rows.about: Tests every key in ~/Downloads/API with one real call each

rows.name: Installation Logger
rows.about: Records every file an installer writes, so it can all be taken out again

rows.name: Speechify splash closer (closes the window Speechify opens at launch)
rows.about: Closes the window Speechify opens at launch, leaving it in the menu bar

rows.name: Star Monitor (every app: start, stop, reorder, what comes back, time run)
rows.about: The page that runs the star: start, stop, reorder, and how long each app has run

rows.name: Claude to Marko voice (Mantra) (the subtitle while the voice speaks)
rows.about: How the spoken words are written on the screens: size, colour, band, where

rows.name: Voice of Claude (Mantra) (the voice engine on and off)
rows.about: One switch: the voice engine on or off, and its three parts

rows.name: Spectral Analyzer (Mantra) (the sound seen: FLUX's meters, clicks found)
rows.about: Any sound passed through and measured like FLUX:: Analyzer; the voice's clips checked for clicks

rows.name: MIDI to MK Control (a knob becomes a Mackie Control command: the playback position under a knob, which Live's own MIDI mapping will not give)
rows.about: A knob on a MIDI controller becomes a Mackie Control command in Live

rows.name: MIDI to Key Stroke (a knob's CC or a key's note becomes a key, or the system volume)
rows.about: A knob's CC or a key's note becomes a key stroke, or the Mac's own volume

rows.name: G815 Lights (every key of the Logitech G815 its own still colour)
rows.about: Every key of the G815 its own still colour and brightness, three banks M1 M2 M3, painted at every start

rows.name: Star Menu (alt+space, search and open)
rows.about: This box: alt+space searches the Mac's applications and the rows of this menu

rows.name: djay Sync (Mantra) (djay Pro's playlists <-> DJ Mantra on the phone, over adb)
rows.about: Both sides in one window, each playlist SAME / NEW / CHANGED; SYNC Mac -> phone, PULL phone -> djay; can sync by itself when the phone appears

rows.name: DJ Transfer Monitor (Mantra) (what is copying to the phone: from which Mac folder into which phone folder, how fast)
rows.about: Live view of djay-sync / adb push: playlist, file, FROM -> TO, file and total bars, MB/s, ETA, files done and skipped

rows.name: Screenshot to TIDAL (Mantra) (screenshots of a chart or tracklist -> a playlist on your TIDAL)
rows.about: Reads the newest 3 Desktop screenshots on the Mac (Vision), artist / title rows, finds each on TIDAL with a confidence, CREATE PLAYLIST on his account
